Old-format save codes for the step 10 and 11B playtests.
A/B are real old-shaped saves taken from the project's test fixtures; C is a
pre-11B v15 regression fixture. Paste one
into Saves -> Import in the NEW build. Importing replaces your current game, so
export your own code first if you want to keep it.

=== A) OLD v12 FLAT SAVE (no place saved) ===
Expect: loads fine, credits 4850, ships Wasp + Prospector, and you end up DOCKED at
Meridian Station (old saves with no place default to the starting pocket).

=== B) OLD v13 SPLIT SAVE (world.sector = "hollow") ===
Expect: loads fine, credits 4850, and you resume FLYING in Kestrel Hollow at the
arrival point, because that old save was made away from the station.

=== C) PRE-11B v15 SPLIT SAVE (world.resume, galaxy:null) ===
Expect: loads fine in the 11B build, credits 4850, ships Wasp + Prospector, and you
resume FLYING in Kestrel Hollow at the saved spot (not the arrival point). Cargo,
fittings, mission and station storage are preserved. This fixture was produced by
the pre-11B sanitizer from the real v13 character plus a v15 flying resume; it is a
regression code, not a newly exported owner save.
